blocks.value: Congratulations! You have completed 100 lessons covering the complete journey from understanding money to building a disciplined investment strategy.

Imagine This: The day you learned the alphabet wasn't the day you became a great writer. It was simply the beginning. In the same way, completing this course isn't the end—it's the start of your investing journey.

You now understand:

✅ Money
✅ Saving & Investing
✅ Businesses & Companies
✅ Shares
✅ Stock Market
✅ NSE, BSE & SEBI
✅ Demat & Trading Accounts
✅ Buying & Selling Stocks
✅ Price Movement
✅ Charts
✅ Technical Analysis
✅ Fundamental Analysis
✅ Risk Management
✅ Portfolio Building
✅ IPOs, Mutual Funds, ETFs & SIPs
✅ Taxes & Corporate Actions
The best investment you will ever make is continuing to learn. Read books, follow quality businesses, stay disciplined, and let time work in your favor.

🏆 Welcome to the lifelong journey of investing.

Remember:

'You don't need to become rich overnight.
You need to become wiser every year.'

blocks.question: What should you do after completing this course?
choices: Continue learning, practise patiently, and invest with discipline.
Invest all your savings in one stock immediately.
Stop learning because you know everything.
